evidence: A user configures several five-minute sessions daily and says the interruptions help break addictive news and social-media use.

evidence_sources.author: liorgrossman
evidence_sources.excerpt: I use ScreenZen to enforce limited short session for a short list of harmful apps and websites (socials & news), and I configured it to allow a few 5-min-long sessions per day. The short sessions being cut in the middle help me stay informed but break the addictive nature of socials/news.
